reason: The primary replication report (Case_Demography_2011_5Kgq, osf.io/nuzh2) uniquely identifies the unweighted new-data-only OLS regression of antenatal care on HIV prevalence with region-clustered standard errors as the focal test and prints the unstandardized OLS regression coefficient Coef. = .0801496 (SE = .2405655, t = 0.33, p = 0.739). However, the requested metric es_type_r is 'ser_method', which is not reported or defined in the primary text or coding_context and has no reproducible transformation or mathematical identity establishing equivalence to the unstandardized multiple-regression OLS coefficient (not_comparable).
